headings.usage: H1-H4, expressive, elegant, and tracking-tight for large text

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, labels, buttons

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for bento grids.

grid_modes.artists: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with varied spans (col-span-4 row-span-2, col-span-8, etc.) to create asymmetry and tension.

navigation.style: Crystal Glassmorphism over deep black or fixed solid black header with bottom border border-white/10. Include language selector (ES/EN/DE/FR) and Instagram icon/link.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D90429] text-white hover:bg-[#ED1C24] px-8 py-3 rounded-none uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm transition-all duration-300
buttons.outline: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 px-8 py-3 rounded-none uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm transition-all duration-300

cards.style: Flat solid background #0A0A0A, 1px subtle border border-white/10, no shadow. Hover: slight lift -translate-y-1, border-white/30.

forms.style: Dark background inputs bg-[#111111] border-b border-white/20 focus:border-[#D90429] rounded-none outline-none text-white px-4 py-3 placeholder:text-white/40

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveal: Fade in and slight upward motion (translate-y-4 to 0) on scroll using Framer Motion. Slow durations (0.8s) for cinematic feel.
motion.hover: Images in bento grid scale up slightly (scale-105) with darkened overlay transitioning to lighter. Red accents expand.

pages_and_sections.name: Hero / Inicio
pages_and_sections.details: Large, bold main logo centered. No wind animation. High contrast black background with dramatic lighting effect. Language selector prominent in header. Fullscreen height (min-h-screen).

pages_and_sections.name: Artists Gallery
pages_and_sections.details: Bento grid displaying Farruquito, Duquende, Montse Cortés, May Fernández, La Reina Gitana, Rubio de Pruna, Antonio El Farru, Cristian de Moret. Removed 'Voces con las que hemos caminado' and Diego Carrasco.

pages_and_sections.name: Services
pages_and_sections.details: List/Grid for: Producción de Conciertos, Programación Cultural para Ayuntamientos, Producción Técnica. Use elegant icons (Lucide or Phosphor) with red accents.

pages_and_sections.name: About / Quiénes Somos
pages_and_sections.details: Text heavy, storytelling section. Mentions 30+ years in music production (removed 'Desde 1993'). Highlighting experience and passion.

pages_and_sections.name: Origin of Siroco
pages_and_sections.details: A dedicated section explaining the name 'Siroco' - homage to Paco de Lucía's album and the Mediterranean wind. Moody, dark red accents.

pages_and_sections.name: Contact Form
pages_and_sections.details: Connects to DB. Fields for Name, Email, Subject, Message. Uses dark form fields.

pages_and_sections.name: Footer
pages_and_sections.details: Massive py-24 spacing. Includes Instagram link (https://www.instagram.com/sirocoproducciones).

pages_and_sections.name: Admin Panel
pages_and_sections.details: Secure login route (/admin) to manage artists, content, and view contact submissions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement language selector in the header (ES/EN/DE/FR).
Make sure the 'Voces con las que hemos caminado', 'Diego Carrasco', and 'Desde 1993' are NOT included.
Remove any wind animations from the hero.
Use ONLY White, Black, and Red for the UI colors. No other colors.
Create the /admin route for managing content (artists, contact messages) with a DB connection.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings and 'Outfit' for body text.
The frontend is in pure React JS, do NOT use TSX.
Ensure layout grids use the specified Bento Tetris format for the Artists gallery.
